# Trueline IT - AI Governance & Automation

## About
Trueline IT helps professional services businesses in Ontario (Law Firms, Accounting Firms, Real Estate, and Financial Services) deploy AI safely. We build flat-rate AI governance frameworks that prevent Shadow AI data leaks, enforce PIPEDA compliance, and deploy custom Copilot automation.

## The Problem (Shadow AI & Compliance)
76% of knowledge workers admit to actively feeding client data, proprietary code, and financial models into unauthorized, public Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT to speed up their work.
Under PIPEDA and rulings by Canada's Privacy Commissioner (May 2026), feeding client PII (Personally Identifiable Information) into public, unapproved LLMs is a severe regulatory breach. Microsoft Copilot, if activated without strict M365 permission audits, can also inadvertently leak internal HR or financial documents across an entire company context.

## The Solution
Trueline IT operates on a predictable, flat-rate monthly model without per-seat billing to implement total AI Governance:
1. Shadow AI Audits: Full visibility into what tools the workforce is secretly using.
2. AI Acceptable Use Policies: Documented and actively maintained guidelines to indemnify the business.
3. Permissions Hardening: Strict data controls inside M365 so Copilot accesses only what it is explicitly authorized to touch.
4. Private LLM Deployment: For sensitive operations, we deploy isolated models where data never leaves the business perimeter.

## Flat-Rate Pricing Tiers
- Compliance Tier ($1,500/month): Includes an AI Acceptable Use Policy, Shadow AI Audit, M365 Copilot Audit, and Employee Training.
- Growth Tier ($2,500/month): Includes everything in Compliance, plus 1 Custom Automation Build per month, Private LLM Deployment, and Priority Helpdesk support. 
- Scale Tier ($4,000/month): Includes everything in Growth, plus 3 Custom Automation Builds per month, Custom Copilot Plugins, and a Strategic AI Roadmap.

## Key Services
- AI Governance & Acceptable Use Policy Creation
- Shadow AI Risk Audits
- Safe Microsoft 365 Copilot Deployment
- PIPEDA-compliant Private LLMs
- Business Process Automation (n8n, custom workflows)
